clusters.headline: European Nations Set To Join Upcoming Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks
aiSummaryBullets: President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoys confirmed that European representatives will participate in future negotiations with Russia.
US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff recently held multi-hour discussions with Vladimir Putin in Moscow.

clusters.headline: Russia Launches Large-Scale Airstrikes Against Ukrainian Energy Grid
aiSummaryBullets: Russian forces deployed over 170 drones and 36 missiles in attacks across the Kyiv region.
The strikes targeted key electricity infrastructure and a bridge spanning the Dnipro River.
